build_DataTransforms_pipeline: build a DataTransforms pipeline that applies multiple dataset-specific transforms to AtomicData objects using a config dictionary
create_ani1x_transform: create a transform that centers molecules in a large periodic cell for the ANI-1x dataset
create_qm9_transform: create a transform that centers QM9 molecules in a large periodic cell with fixed atom flags
create_decompose_tensor: create a function that decomposes a rank-2 tensor into irreducible representation components using Clebsch-Gordan change of basis
create_stress_reshape_transform: create a transform that reshapes stress tensor fields from flat to 1x9 format for AtomicData objects
